messages.body: Retry payment reads like the error is still there. Can the primary action say Pay now in both Locales?

This Checkout frame is the reviewed View inside the canvas mock, and its "Pay label copy" thread (thread-open Variant) models exactly this change, so the mock keeps "Retry payment" on purpose. Note: the Workbench shows this pin as "Not visible in this state" because the mock pin-ml button overlaps #checkout-submit and the geometry proof fails closed on native-control occluders.
